about: Generated by scripts/completion-census.py; read by scripts/completion-check.py. readers: package directory -> test -> index into sets. A set names the repository paths outside the package directory that are tracked or nonignored at collection time. Ignored-only generated paths are excluded; `D/*` is every tracked file directly in D, `D/*.E` every one with that extension; `D/**` is D and every tracked directory under it. Regenerate, do not edit.
